subsystem.name: GenericRuntimeObjects
subsystem.responsibility: Heterogeneous set of generic runtime object primitives: doubly- and singly-linked list containers with node appends and iterator advancement, name/string lookup helpers over list and hash-table structures, sprite/bitmap name accessors, UI state getters/setters, constructor and destructor wrappers (MSVC deleting-destructor patterns), a recursive directory deletion routine, a widget rectangle bounds/clip pair, a global scoring-state reset block, and speed/velocity scalar readers over the dword_7C54E0 data block. All packet owners are UNKNOWN, so every class below is a GUESS grouping on shared field-layout evidence; equal offsets on unrelated this pointers are kept separate unless a base expression links them.

summary: Reconstruction of generic runtime objects from 35 validated function IR records. No packet owner is named, so all classes are GUESS-level groupings anchored on shared field layouts and call patterns. The strongest cross-function grouping is the SpeedScalarProvider cluster (0x0049B8D0, 0x0049B900, 0x0049B950) which all read float fields under the same global pointer dword_7C54E0 (velocity components at +0x34F8/0x34FC/0x3500, speed float at +0x39A0). The doubly-linked list (0x00496750, head/tail/secondary/count at this+0x18BC/0x18C0/0x18C4/0x18C8 with 16-byte nodes) and the named search list (0x00497650, head this+0x4, cursor this+0xC, node name at +0x34) form two distinct list families. Widget rectangle arithmetic links 0x0049AAD0 and 0x0049AB60 through the shared 16-bit rectangle at this+0x24..0x2A. Constructor/destructor wrappers (0x00498D20, 0x00499260, 0x004995E0, 0x0049A5A0) and UI state field accessors form single-method classes. Every function's matched node data, call relationships, and field bases are attributed in function_roles; contradictions (packet-listed fields absent from raw source, ABI names that do not match raw semantics) are recorded in unresolved.

function_roles.role: DoublyLinkedListAppendWithFlag: allocates a 16-byte node (value, next, prev, byte) via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper (0x00587C03), links it after the tail this+0x18C0 (or initializes head this+0x18BC and secondary this+0x18C4 on first insertion), updates the tail and increments the count this+0x18C8; when a3 is non-zero sets the byte flag this+0x24 to 1; returns a3. Called by GameObjectUpdateFrame and DirectoryChangeHandler.

SearchListItemByName: caches the list head this+0x4 into the traversal cursor this+0xC, walks nodes (first dword = data, +4 = next, name at node+0x34 defaulting to global byte_5EA438) comparing names with a2 via sub_588410 (returns 0 on match per existing analysis); returns the matched node's data dword or 0 when empty/exhausted/no match. Sole caller sub_49A5D0.

GetSpriteBitmapName: guarded accessor returning the name string of a bitmap/sprite descriptor. Reads the descriptor pointer from this+0x18; returns 0 when it or the guard field this+0x60 is null. Otherwise reads the sub-descriptor pointer at this+0x68 and returns the name pointer at its offset 0x34, falling back to global byte_5EA438 when null. Invoked by sub_404B60 and KeyBindingUIPressKeyOrController.

delegateToShortComputation5b30: thin __thiscall delegation thunk forwarding this unchanged to ShortComputation_5b30; returns void. Reached from sub_49A5D0. The ABI-name 'polling loop' is not visible in the raw thunk source.
clearField20: trivial void thiscall that unconditionally writes 0 to the DWORD at this+0x20. Acts as a reset/clear for a UI state field. Invoked by UIWidgetVisibilityToggle at 0x0048B91A.
SetDwordAndFlag: stores parameter a2 into the DWORD field this+0x18A8, sets the byte field this+0x18EC to 1 (activation/dirty flag), and returns a2. Unconditional, no guards. Called by sub_49A5D0.

setByteField18F5: char-returning thiscall writing the byte argument a2 to the single-byte field this+0x18F5 and returning a2 unchanged. Simple flag/toggle setter. Invoked by KeyBindingUIPressKeyOrController (0x0046B0C0) and sub_46BF10 (0x0046BF10).
getFloatFieldC4: double-returning thiscall reading the float at this+0xC4 and returning it widened to double. Read-only getter, no side effects. Invoked by UIScrollListUpdate (0x0048A8D0).

InitWithVTableParam: thiscall constructor. Calls parent constructor ConstructorWith1Sentinels (0x0049A930), writes the vtable pointer off_5AC9E8 to this+0x0, calls MultiFieldStructInit (0x00498DF0), stores constructor argument a2 at this+0x44, and returns this. Called by ConstructorWithVTableAndSubInit_9140 (0x00499140).

LinkedListAppendWithChildLinking: increments the node counter this+0x5C, walks a2's child list (first child a2[36], linked via offset 0x8C) setting each child's back-links (child+0x98 = this, child+0x9C = 0), calls MultiRegionOffsetAccumulationWithVTableDispatch (0x004869E0) with (a2, this[3], this[1]), then appends a2 to the tail of the list anchored at this+0x4C via the 0x8C next pointers (or sets this+0x4C = a2 on empty). Returns a2. Called by SetInitCall (0x004975B0).

GetDwordField0x4C: trivial getter returning the dword at this+0x4C. No side effects, guards, or callees. Invoked by ShortComputation_58d0 (0x004958D0), ObjectSearchWithDoubleIteration (0x00495980) and DualListDestruction (0x00498D90).

ConditionalDestructor_9260: scalar deleting-destructor wrapper (MSVC pattern). Always runs DestructorWithListWalk (0x00499280); when the low bit of flag a2 is set frees the object via FreeWrapper_7bcf (0x00587BCF); returns this. No field or global access.

DestructorWithDataFree: destructor helper. When the flag byte at this+0x8 is set, captures the pointer at this+0x0 and, if non-null, calls FreeIfNonNull (0x00499AE0) on it and frees the captured block via FreeWrapper_7bcf (0x00587BCF). When (a2 & 1) is set additionally frees the object itself via FreeWrapper_7bcf. Returns this. Invoked by sub_495300 (0x00495300).

recursiveDeleteFiles: recursively deletes files under a directory path. Validates the path, normalizes a trailing backslash (word_5C2AAC), appends the file search pattern pointed to by dword_5C2AB8, then enumerates with FindFirstFileA/FindNextFileA/FindClose (globals 0x0059E0E0/0x0059E0E4/0x0059E0E8). For files it clears the read-only attribute (ToggleFileReadOnlyAttributeViaWin32API 0x0058BA36) and deletes (FileDeleteWithErrorHandling 0x0058986E); the first successful file deletion aborts the walk. Directory entries (0x10 attribute) are skipped when ".." or matching word_5BEB48, otherwise the function recurses (self-call). On exhaustion without a deletion, calls sub_59B9F3 and returns (result == 0). Called by ProfileAlreadyExistsPageHandler (0x0046CB50).

SmallStructInit: struct initializer writing literal 3 into the dword at this+0x0, a zero byte at this+0x4, then zeroing dwords this+0x8/0xC/0x10/0x14. No reads, globals, or callees. Returns 0. Invoked by 0x00499840 and 0x004998E0.

LinkedListIteratorAdvance: advances a linked-list iterator by one node. Guards on the current node this+0x10 (false when exhausted); loads the container this+0xC, refreshes the container traversal slot (container+0xC) from the current node's link field (+4 via the temporary at this+0x18), dereferences the first dword of the next-candidate node (*(this+0x18)) to obtain the new current node, stores it to this+0x10, updates this+0x14 with FieldGetter_8e30 (0x00498E30). Returns (this+0x10 != 0). Invoked from sub_499910.

LinkedListNodeTraversal_98c0: advances a linked-list iterator one step: reads the next node pointer at node+72 (0x48) from the current node stored at this+0x14, replaces this+0x14 with it, and returns true while a node remains; returns false when the current node is NULL.

StringFieldSetter: string-and-id thiscall setter. Calls StringCopyWithBufferRealloc (0x00566650) on a2, assigns the result to the DWORD slot this+0x8, and returns the copy result. Used by SpriteTextureEnumeration (0x00498950) during string/resource field assignment.

ObjectConstructorInit: thiscall constructor initializing 13 DWORD fields this+0x0 through this+0x30, all zeroed except this+0x18 set to 1036831949 (float 0.1). No callees or guards. Called by UIObjectConstructor_7ea0 (0x00477EA0), UIObjectConstructor_8e10 (0x00478E10), UITextDisplayConstructor (0x00488180) and sub_499F70 (0x00499F70).

ObjectFieldInitWithIndirectLookup: constructor-style initializer storing parameter a2 into this+0x20 and zeroing this+0x0 and this+0x8. When a2 is non-null, reads two values through two-level pointer indirection from a2+12 (offsets +28 into this+0x4 and +32 into this+0xC); otherwise this+0x4 is zeroed and this+0xC stays 0. Returns a2 if null, else the dereferenced a2+12 value. Called by ProfileIconDFTBmpDefaultIconLoader (0x00478020).

StructEquality: compares two DWORD-array objects field by field, short-circuiting on the first mismatch. Checks six DWORD fields at offsets 0x0, 0x4, 0x8, 0xC, 0x1C and 0x20 in order; returns TRUE only if all six match. Fields between 0x10-0x18 and above 0x24 are not compared. Called by ShortComputation_9bf0 (0x00499BF0).
SetDwordField0x68: trivial setter storing argument a2 into this+0x68 and returning a2 unchanged. No guards, callees, or globals. Invoked by ConditionalSingleStoreWithIteration (0x0049A1C0).

LookupOrCreateResourceNodeAndLink: looks up a named resource via sub_497AD0 with the context at this+0x4. On success allocates a 52-byte node (OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper 0x00587C03), initializes it via sub_499B10, fills slots with caller arguments a2-a5 and the lookup result, optionally overrides slots from the resource's indirect data when a7 is set, then links the node either into a named node's child list (when a9 matches a list node) or into the main list anchored at this+0x8 (next pointers at +36/0x24), incrementing the counter at this+0xC. On lookup failure with a8 set, formats an error message (0x0058815F) and shows a MessageBoxA (titles/strings 0x005CCB18/0x005CCB30, window 0x0059E2A4). Returns the new node or 0.

ListCleanupWithVTableDestructor: repeatedly pops the head node of a linked list stored at this[0], advancing the stored head via sub_499E00 (0x00499E00), and for each node invokes its vtable destructor with argument 1. Runs while the stored head is non-null. Called by sub_495300.

ThunkToFUN00566650: __thiscall forwarding thunk to StringCopyWithBufferRealloc (0x00566650). Passes both arguments through unchanged (this as destination, a2 as source string) and returns the callee's result. Invoked by ResourceLookupOrCreate (0x0049A3B0).

CharToIndexConversion: __stdcall helper converting the first character of a string to an index: calls sub_589901 (0x00589901) on the string, computes result = first_char - 65 ('A'); returns -1 when result >= 0x1A (26) (non A-Z), otherwise the 0-based index (A -> 0, Z -> 25). Used by hash/resource lookup paths (callers 0x0049A360, 0x0049A3B0, 0x0049A520).

StringNormalizeLookup_a460: string lookup helper that normalizes the input string via sub_589901 (0x00589901), searches the hash table owned by this (0x0049A360), and returns the stored string pointer through StringPointerAccessor_a2d0 (0x0049A2D0) if found, else null. Callers are UI control handlers.

DualConditionalFree: destructor-style helper that conditionally frees two pointer fields of this (first this+0xC, then this+0x4), each only when non-NULL, via FreeWrapper_7bcf (0x00587BCF). Returns the result of the last free call that fired, or 0 when neither pointer was set.

WidgetRectBounds: computes a widget's output bounding rectangle into four caller-supplied output pointers. When the 16-bit height this+0x28 or width this+0x2A is not greater than 0, copies the raw dword rectangle at this+0x4/0x8/0xC/0x10 straight through. Otherwise computes pixel-accurate bounds from the 16-bit start coordinates and extents: left = this+0x26, right = this+0x26 + this+0x2A - 1, top = this+0x24, bottom = this+0x24 + this+0x28 - 1. Returns the a4 output pointer.

RectangleClipAndDispatch: clips an input rectangle against a widget's stored 16-bit rectangle at this+0x24..0x2A, then dispatches the result to ShortComputation_16e0 (0x004916E0). When either widget extent (0x28 or 0x2A) is <= 0 the clipping is skipped and the original unclipped bounds are dispatched; otherwise the rectangle is clamped (top/bottom against origin 0x26 and extent 0x2A, left/right against origin 0x24 and extent 0x28) and the clipped rectangle is dispatched.

CleanupCallbackRegister: thin wrapper calling EmptyStub_0170 with the global dword_7CE048 (0x007CE048) as its argument and returning the result. The raw source shows only this single call/return; the global's content and the stub's behavior are not established.

resetScoringStateBlock: resets five consecutive global data structures by calling sub_49E8F0 (0x0049E8F0) on each (0x7CE0B8, 0x7CE104, 0x7CE150, 0x7CE19C, 0x7CE1E8), then zeroes dword_7CE058 and the 96-byte global block 0x7CE058..0x7CE0B4. Returns 0. Unconditional sequence.

SpeedMultiplier: reads a float from the global-pointered data block dword_7C54E0 at field offset 14752 (0x39A0), scales it by the fixed constant 9.549296585513721 (dbl_59EA38), and returns the product as a double. No arguments or side effects. Caller 0x0049F530.

SpeedMagnitude: computes the scalar speed magnitude of the object referenced by dword_7C54E0. Reads three float components at offsets 13560/13564/13568 (0x34F8/0x34FC/0x3500, interpreted as velocity), squares and sums them, takes the square root, multiplies by the conversion constant 3.5999999 (flt_5ACAF4, m/s-to-km/h per existing analysis), and returns the result truncated to int. Called by GlobalStateBranchFormat (0x0049D3F0) and UILayoutDispatchWithDataPrep (0x004DB550).

SpeedMagnitude_b950: sibling of SpeedMagnitude. Reads the same three float velocity components at dword_7C54E0 + 0x34F8/0x34FC/0x3500, squares and sums, takes the square root, multiplies by the conversion constant 2.2369363 (flt_59F128, m/s-to-mph per existing analysis), and returns the result truncated to int. Selected by the calling formatter based on an encoding flag. Same callers as SpeedMagnitude.

classes.name: DoublyLinkedListWithFlag
classes.responsibility: Doubly-linked list container with head this+0x18BC, tail this+0x18C0, a secondary pointer this+0x18C4 (possibly a read cursor, inferred), node count this+0x18C8, and an append flag byte this+0x24. Single method appends 16-byte DoublyLinkedListNode records and, when the third argument is non-zero, marks the append flag.

classes.name: DoublyLinkedListNode
classes.responsibility: Doubly-linked list node record: 16-byte layout with a value slot at +0, next at +4, prev at +8 and a byte flag at +12, inferred from the initialization literals of 0x00496750 (the meaning of the byte at +12 is unknown). Only the next pointer at +4 is directly evidenced by the packet (as the old tail's next write); the other members are recorded as prose only.

classes.name: NamedListContainer
classes.responsibility: Linked-list container whose nodes carry a name string: list head at this+0x4 and traversal cursor at this+0xC; nodes hold a data dword at +0, a next pointer at +4 and a name pointer at +0x34 (defaulting to global byte_5EA438). Single method searches the list by name using sub_588410 as the comparison predicate.

classes.name: NamedListNode
classes.responsibility: Linked-list node record for NamedListContainer: data dword at +0, next link at +4, and name string pointer at +0x34 (fallback global byte_5EA438). Only the name pointer at +0x34 is directly evidenced by the packet; the data/next members are recorded as prose only.

classes.name: SpriteBitmapNameProvider
classes.responsibility: Object exposing a bitmap/sprite descriptor name accessor: descriptor pointer at this+0x18, a guard field at this+0x60 (descriptor+0x48), and a sub-descriptor pointer at this+0x68 (descriptor+0x50) whose name pointer at sub+0x34 is returned (fallback global byte_5EA438).

classes.name: ComputationDelegationThunk
classes.responsibility: Thin __thiscall delegation thunk forwarding its this pointer unchanged to ShortComputation_5b30 and returning void. Provides no field evidence; the delegated callee address is not named by the packet.

classes.name: UiStateFieldOwner
classes.responsibility: Object with a DWORD state field at this+0x20 that is unconditionally cleared to 0 by a UI visibility-toggle callback path. The field semantics are unknown.

classes.name: DataAndDirtyFlagSetterOwner
classes.responsibility: Object with a data DWORD at this+0x18A8 and an activation/dirty flag byte at this+0x18EC; the setter stores an argument into the data field and sets the flag to 1 unconditionally. Meaning of the fields is not established.

classes.name: ByteFlagSetterOwner
classes.responsibility: Object with a single-byte flag at this+0x18F5 that a char-returning setter writes from its argument and returns unchanged. Likely a boolean/toggle given the UI/key-binding callers.

classes.name: FloatFieldGetterOwner
classes.responsibility: Object exposing a float field at this+0xC4 read through a double-returning getter; consumed by a UI scroll-list update path. Field semantics unknown.

classes.name: VTableInitConstructorOwner
classes.responsibility: Object constructed by 0x00498D20: parent constructor (0x0049A930) first, vtable off_5AC9E8 installed at this+0x0, a block of fields initialized via MultiFieldStructInit (0x00498DF0), and a constructor argument stored at this+0x44. Purpose of the stored argument is unknown.

classes.name: ChildLinkedListContainer
classes.responsibility: Container that appends nodes with child-list linking: node counter this+0x5C, two accumulation arguments this+0x4 and this+0xC fed to MultiRegionOffsetAccumulationWithVTableDispatch (0x004869E0), a list head this+0x4C, and an anchor object this+0xD8 used for the 0x8C traversal (role inferred). Children are linked via 0x8C next pointers and receive back-links at child+0x98 (parent) and child+0x9C.

classes.name: DwordField4CGetterOwner
classes.responsibility: Object exposing a dword field at this+0x4C through a trivial getter. Read by three unrelated callers (0x004958D0, 0x00495980, 0x00498D90); equal offsets on unrelated this pointers are not proof of identical classes.

classes.name: ScalarDeletingDestructorOwner
classes.responsibility: Object whose teardown is a scalar deleting-destructor wrapper: an unconditional list-walking body (DestructorWithListWalk, 0x00499280) plus a flag-gated self-free (FreeWrapper_7bcf, 0x00587BCF when a2 & 1). The list layout inside the body is not evidenced here.

classes.name: DataFreeDestructorOwner
classes.responsibility: Object with a data pointer at this+0x0 and an ownership/state flag byte at this+0x8; the destructor helper releases the data pointer (FreeIfNonNull 0x00499AE0 + block free 0x00587BCF) when the flag is set, and self-frees when the caller flag bit is set.

classes.name: RecursiveDirectoryCleaner
classes.responsibility: Free procedural helper (no instance fields) that recursively deletes files under a directory using the Win32 FindFirstFileA/FindNextFileA/FindClose enumeration API, clearing read-only attributes before deletion, skipping ".." and the word_5BEB48 entry, recursing into subdirectories, and aborting on the first successful file deletion.

classes.name: SmallStructInitOwner
classes.responsibility: Small struct whose initializer writes literal 3 to the first dword this+0x0, a zero byte at this+0x4, and zeroes four dwords (this+0x8/0xC/0x10/0x14). Role of the literal and the mixed byte/dword layout are unknown.

classes.name: LinkedListIteratorOwner
classes.responsibility: Linked-list iterator object: container pointer this+0xC, current node this+0x10, extracted value this+0x14, and a traversal temporary this+0x18 through which the container traversal slot (at container+0xC) and the next-candidate node (first dword of *(this+0x18)) are read. The advance method refreshes the container slot and extracts the new node's value via FieldGetter_8e30 (0x00498E30).

classes.name: LinkedListCursorOwner
classes.responsibility: Object holding an iterator cursor at this+0x14; the advance method replaces the cursor with the next node pointer read at node+72 (0x48) and returns whether a node remains. The node type and the meaning of the +72 next pointer are not established beyond pointer math.

classes.name: StringSlotSetterOwner
classes.responsibility: Object with a DWORD slot at this+0x8 assigned during string assignment; the string is copied through StringCopyWithBufferRealloc (0x00566650) and the copy result is returned to the caller (SpriteTextureEnumeration). Whether this+0x8 stores the copy or the separate id argument is contradictory in the packet and unresolved.

classes.name: ZeroFieldConstructorOwner
classes.responsibility: Object constructed by 0x00499B10: thirteen DWORD fields this+0x0..0x30 initialized to zero except this+0x18 set to float 0.1 (1036831949). Reused as a base/embedded init by four UI-object constructors (0x00477EA0, 0x00478E10, 0x00488180, 0x00499F70).

classes.name: IndirectLookupInitOwner
classes.responsibility: Object whose initializer stores a caller-provided source pointer at this+0x20, zeroes this+0x0 and this+0x8, and copies two values from a two-level indirect read (through a2+12, offsets +28 and +32) into this+0x4 and this+0xC when the source is non-null. The source object's layout is unknown.

classes.name: SixDwordEqualityOwner
classes.responsibility: Object whose equality operation compares six DWORD fields (this+0x0/0x4/0x8/0xC/0x1C/0x20) against a peer and short-circuits on the first mismatch. The skipped regions (0x10-0x18, 0x24+) are deliberately omitted; the object type is unidentified.

classes.name: DwordField68SetterOwner
classes.responsibility: Object exposing a dword field at this+0x68 through a trivial setter that stores and returns its argument. Field meaning unknown; the structural-twin relation to 0x00464BB0 is a cluster observation, not proof of class identity.

classes.name: ResourceNodeRegistry
classes.responsibility: Registry of named resource nodes: lookup context at this+0x4, main list head at this+0x8 (nodes linked by +36/0x24 next pointers), and node counter at this+0xC. The create-or-link method (0x00499F70) allocates and initializes 52-byte ResourceNode records, optionally links them under a matching named node, and reports lookup failures through a formatted message box when the reporting flag is set.

classes.name: ResourceNode
classes.responsibility: 52-byte resource record allocated by 0x00499F70 and initialized by sub_499B10. Slots are filled from caller arguments and the lookup result, with an optional indirect-data override; the +36/0x24 next pointer chains the main list and a child-list is reachable through a later slot. Only the +0x24 next pointer is directly evidenced by the packet; slot meanings (0-10, including counters, resource handle, parent/child-list next) are recorded as prose only.

classes.name: ListCleanupWithVTableDestructorOwner
classes.responsibility: Object with a list head at this+0x0 whose cleanup method pops each head node (successor via sub_499E00, 0x00499E00) and dispatches the node's vtable destructor with argument 1 until the head is null.

classes.name: StringCopyForwardingThunk
classes.responsibility: Thin __thiscall forwarding thunk that passes its this pointer and a2 unchanged to StringCopyWithBufferRealloc (0x00566650) and returns the callee's result. Used while resolving/creating resources (caller 0x0049A3B0).

classes.name: CharToIndexConverter
classes.responsibility: Free __stdcall helper converting the first character of a string (via sub_589901 0x00589901) into a 0-based A-Z index (first_char - 65), returning -1 for any character outside A-Z. The 'this' base label is the string argument. Used by hash/resource lookup paths.

classes.name: StringNormalizeHashLookupOwner
classes.responsibility: Object owning a string hash table (this); the lookup method normalizes the input via sub_589901 (0x00589901), searches the table (0x0049A360), and returns the stored string through StringPointerAccessor_a2d0 (0x0049A2D0) on a hit. Hash-table layout and entry semantics are unknown.

classes.name: DualPointerFreeOwner
classes.responsibility: Object with two pointer fields (this+0xC and this+0x4) that a helper frees via FreeWrapper_7bcf (0x00587BCF), each only when non-null, returning the last free result. Whether the two offsets are sibling members of one object or separate allocations is unproven.

classes.name: WidgetRectBoundsProvider
classes.responsibility: Widget object exposing a bounding-rectangle computation: a raw dword rectangle at this+0x4/0x8/0xC/0x10 and a 16-bit layout rectangle at this+0x24 (top start) / this+0x26 (left start) / this+0x28 (height extent) / this+0x2A (width extent). The computed path returns pixel-accurate bounds (right = left + width - 1, bottom = top + height - 1).

classes.name: RectangleClipDispatcher
classes.responsibility: Object whose clip method clamps an input rectangle against the widget 16-bit rectangle at this+0x24..0x2A (origin 0x24/0x26, extents 0x28/0x2A) and dispatches the clipped (or unclipped when an extent is <= 0) result to ShortComputation_16e0 (0x004916E0). Origin-vs-extent and x-vs-y roles are inferred from the clamp arithmetic.

classes.name: CleanupCallbackRegisterOwner
classes.responsibility: Thin wrapper over a single call to EmptyStub_0170 with the global dword_7CE048 (0x007CE048) as its argument; returns the stub result. The global's content, the stub's behavior, and the ABI-name cleanup-callback role are not corroborated by raw source evidence.

classes.name: ScoringStateBlockResetter
classes.responsibility: Procedural reset of five consecutive global data structures (0x7CE0B8, 0x7CE104, 0x7CE150, 0x7CE19C, 0x7CE1E8) via per-struct reset sub_49E8F0 (0x0049E8F0), plus zeroing of dword_7CE058 and the 96-byte block 0x7CE058..0x7CE0B4. Per-member roles of the zeroed block are unnamed.

classes.name: SpeedScalarProvider
classes.responsibility: Reader set over the global data block rooted at dword_7C54E0: velocity components at offsets 0x34F8/0x34FC/0x3500 (squared-summed, square-rooted and scaled by 3.6 or 2.2369363 to yield truncated int speed) and a speed float at offset 0x39A0 scaled by 9.549296585513721. The packet provides no field refs under the *(dword_7C54E0) base, so these offsets are recorded as prose only; the three methods form one cluster because they share the same base pointer and velocity layout.

state_machines.name: DoublyLinkedListInsertion
states: empty (head this+0x18BC null; first insert sets head, secondary this+0x18C4 and tail this+0x18C0)
non_empty (head non-null; append links the old tail's next to the new node and updates the tail)
transitions: Both paths allocate a 16-byte node, set the node's value/next/prev/byte, increment the count this+0x18C8 and, when the third argument is non-zero, set the append flag byte this+0x24 to 1. The transition empty -> non_empty happens on the first insertion.

state_machines.name: ResourceNodeLookupOutcome
states: lookup_failed_silent (name null or sub_497AD0 returned null and the report flag a8 is clear)
lookup_failed_reported (lookup null and a8 set: formatted message + MessageBoxA, returns 0)
node_created_linked_child (a9 matches an existing list node: node appended to a9's child list)
node_created_linked_main (no matching node: node appended to the main list at this+0x8, count this+0xC incremented)
transitions: A null name or a failed lookup with a8 clear returns 0 without creating a node. A successful lookup allocates and initializes a 52-byte node and links it into either the child list (when a9 matches) or the main list.

interfaces.name: StringFieldInitialization

interfaces.name: ConditionalFreeHelper
